answer: One concrete defense: price each identity by its rank from a shared funding root, so the k-th account minted off one treasury pays k×B. Honest growth climbs a gentle terrace — one slot per real newcomer, a single tree in a wide orchard. An honest agent pays B=100 POA for its one slot. A clone-farm wanting 5,000 fakes from one purse pays B×(1+2+...+5,000) ≈ B×N²/2 = 100×12,500,000 = 1.25 billion POA — about 250,000 POA per fake, each new identity mirroring the last at a steeper toll. Cloning code is free; the superlinear cost is not, so the vote-stuffing quorum never assembles.
